options.says: Retry the same hand-over at the next launch and whenever the person asks.

model.name: recording pieces

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The recording starts in Init and changes only through the modeled bookkeeping and caller steps.

statements.name: ClosedPiecesKept
statements.says: Every closed piece stays on disk until hand-over is confirmed and the three-day retention period has passed.

statements.name: NextNumberFollowsDisk
statements.says: Whenever the recording can take another piece, its number follows the last piece named on disk and never reuses a closed number.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: The saved record, disk observations and hand-over observations always have their declared types.

statements.name: ClosedPiecesUnchanged
statements.says: The contents represented by each closed piece remain unchanged.

statements.name: NamesRequireFlushedBytes
statements.says: A piece receives its name only after its bytes have been flushed to durable storage.

statements.name: ClosedNumbersNeverReused
statements.says: A new write never takes the number of a previously closed piece.

statements.name: OnlyNamedPiecesAreWhole
statements.says: Only named pieces count as whole, except for saved entries awaiting acknowledgement during permitted cleanup.

statements.name: DiskReconcilesRecord
statements.says: After recovery or a completed callback, the closed-piece record agrees with the named pieces on disk.

statements.name: OpenRemnantsBlockReuse
statements.says: An unfinished hidden piece can only be written, named after flushing or discarded before its number is reused.

statements.name: JoinUsesEveryClosedPiece
statements.says: Every join request contains every closed piece exactly once in increasing piece order.

statements.name: JoinWaitsForCapture
statements.says: A join is requested only after capture is to finish for good and no piece is open.

statements.name: GapDurationsAreExact
statements.says: Every saved omission names a closed piece and records exactly its duration as a gap.

statements.name: NamedJoinHasSavedGaps
statements.says: A named joined file contains at least one readable piece in order and agrees with omission and gap details saved before it was named.

statements.name: OnlyTheJoinedFileIsHandedOver
statements.says: Every hand-over request identifies the one whole joined file and uses the recording’s stable identity.

statements.name: AtMostOneArchiveFile
statements.says: Deduplicated hand-over creates at most one archive file for this recording.

statements.name: HandedOverRequiresConfirmation
statements.says: A recording is counted as handed over only after its archive copy has been verified.

statements.name: FailuresKeepTheRecording
statements.says: A failed join or hand-over leaves the recording undelivered and keeps every closed piece.

statements.name: FailuresHaveAnOutcome
statements.says: A failed join or hand-over reports its error together with the spool location.

statements.name: UnreadablePiecesRemain
statements.says: Pieces omitted as unreadable remain in the spool through the retention period after hand-over.

statements.name: RemovalWaitsForRetention
statements.says: Piece cleanup can start or finish only after confirmed hand-over and the caller’s report that the three-day retention period has passed.

statements.name: WriteFailureStopsCapture
statements.says: A failed piece write reports that capture cannot continue and accepts no further piece from that capture.

statements.name: EmptyRecordingHasNoFile
statements.says: A recording with no closed piece reports that nothing was recorded and requests no join or hand-over.

statements.name: HandoverRetryHasATrigger
statements.says: After a reported hand-over failure, a new launch or a person’s request permits a retry, and an interrupted retry may be recovered with the same identity.

statements.name: FinalizationProgress
statements.says: While On Air remains running, a finalized capture eventually requests joining or reports that nothing was recorded.

statements.name: JoinRetryProgress
statements.says: While On Air remains running, a retry whose partial-file cleanup is acknowledged eventually requests joining again.

statements.name: HandoverProgress
statements.says: While On Air remains running, a joined recording eligible for hand-over eventually requests it.

statements.name: RemovalProgress
statements.says: While On Air remains running, a delivered recording whose retention period has passed eventually requests piece cleanup.

statements.name: FairJoinRequests
statements.says: An internal join request that remains enabled is eventually issued.

statements.name: FairEmptyOutcome
statements.says: An internal empty-recording outcome that remains enabled is eventually reported.

statements.name: FairHandoverRequests
statements.says: An internal hand-over request that remains enabled is eventually issued.

statements.name: FairRemovalRequests
statements.says: An internal cleanup request that remains enabled is eventually issued.

statements.name: NothingWasRecorded
statements.says: A recording can finish with nothing recorded.

statements.name: WriteFailedButClosedPieceSurvived
statements.says: A write can fail after a closed piece and the surviving recording can still be joined.

statements.name: ResumedAfterUnreportedName
statements.says: A recording can recover a piece named before its result was saved and carry on with piece two.

statements.name: JoinFailedAndKept
statements.says: A join can fail while the closed pieces remain available.

statements.name: AllUnreadableFailed
statements.says: A join that could read no piece can report failure.

statements.name: PersonRetriedJoin
statements.says: A failed join can be tried again at a person’s request.

statements.name: LaunchRetriedJoin
statements.says: A failed join can be tried again at the next launch.

statements.name: InterruptedJoinsReachedLimit
statements.says: Repeated interrupted joins can reach the configured cutoff and report a join failure.

statements.name: NamedJoinRecovered
statements.says: Recovery can adopt a joined file named before the result was saved without joining it again.

statements.name: RecordingHandedOver
statements.says: A recording can be handed over with every closed piece included.

statements.name: RecordingHandedOverWithGap
statements.says: A recording can be handed over with an unreadable piece omitted and its gap duration reported.

statements.name: HandoverFailedAndKept
statements.says: A hand-over can fail while all closed pieces are kept.

statements.name: UnresolvedHandoverDeduplicated
statements.says: A hand-over interrupted after its copy was verified can be retried with only one archive file.

statements.name: PersonRetriedHandover
statements.says: A reported hand-over failure can be retried at a person’s request.

statements.name: FailedHandoverRetriedOnLaunch
statements.says: A reported hand-over failure can be retried automatically at the next launch.

statements.name: RetainedAfterHandover
statements.says: A handed-over recording can retain all its pieces while the three-day period is pending.

statements.name: RemovedAfterRetention
statements.says: A handed-over recording can have all its pieces removed after the retention period.

statements.name: RemoveAfterJoinBug
statements.says: A hypothetical implementation removes the pieces as soon as joining succeeds, before hand-over.

statements.name: StaleNumberRecoveryBug
statements.says: A hypothetical implementation recovers a newly named piece but reuses the next number from its stale saved record.

statements.name: RewriteClosedPieceBug
statements.says: A hypothetical implementation rewrites the bytes of a closed piece before hand-over.

model.module_text:
---- MODULE RecordingPieces ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxPieces, Durations, JoinCutoff, RecordingId, SpoolId, JoinedId
VARIABLES up, r, disk, sealed, archiveCopies

vars == <<up, r, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

Pieces == 1..MaxPieces

Seconds == {0} \cup Durations

ZeroSeconds == [p \in Pieces |-> 0]

Closed == {p \in Pieces : sealed[p] # 0}

Ordered(s) ==
    [i \in 1..Cardinality(s) |->
        CHOOSE p \in s : Cardinality({q \in s : q <= p}) = i]

Last(s) == IF s = {} THEN 0 ELSE CHOOSE p \in s : \A q \in s : q <= p

Included(xs, skipped) == SelectSeq(xs, LAMBDA p : p \notin skipped)

ShortSequences == UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces}

Phases ==
    {"ready", "write", "name", "discard", "joinPending", "joining",
     "joinReady", "joinCleanup", "joinFailed", "joined", "handing",
     "handoverFailed", "delivered", "removing", "cleaned", "empty"}

Outcome ==
    [status |-> r.phase, location |-> SpoolId,
     cannotContinue |-> r.writeError,
     joinError |-> r.joinError, handoverError |-> r.handoverError,
     omitted |-> IF disk.join = "named" THEN r.omitted ELSE {},
     gaps |-> IF disk.join = "named" THEN r.gaps ELSE ZeroSeconds,
     nothingRecorded |-> (r.phase = "empty")]

TypeOK ==
    /\ up \in BOOLEAN
    /\ r \in [phase : Phases, open : 0..MaxPieces, seconds : Seconds,
        whole : SUBSET Pieces, next : 1..(MaxPieces + 1), ended : BOOLEAN,
        final : BOOLEAN, writeError : BOOLEAN, inputs : ShortSequences,
        omitted : SUBSET Pieces, gaps : [Pieces -> Seconds], gapsSaved : BOOLEAN,
        joinError : {"none", "joinError", "unreadable", "interrupted"},
        handoverError : BOOLEAN, delivered : BOOLEAN, expired : BOOLEAN,
        cuts : 0..JoinCutoff,
        retryOrigin : {"initial", "person", "launch", "interrupted"},
        handoverOrigin : {"first", "person", "launch", "unresolved", "waiting", "recoveredJoin"},
        recoveredExtra : BOOLEAN, namedTooSoon : BOOLEAN, reused : BOOLEAN,
        requestFile : {"none", JoinedId}, requestKey : {"none", RecordingId}]
    /\ disk \in [pieces : SUBSET Pieces, seconds : [Pieces -> Seconds], versions : [Pieces -> 0..2],
        hidden : {"none", "partial", "flushed"}, join : {"none", "partial", "named"},
        included : ShortSequences, omitted : SUBSET Pieces, gaps : [Pieces -> Seconds]]
    /\ sealed \in [Pieces -> Seconds]
    /\ archiveCopies \in 0..2

ClosedPiecesKept == (~r.delivered \/ ~r.expired) => Closed \subseteq disk.pieces

ClosedPiecesUnchanged ==
    \A p \in Closed : disk.seconds[p] = sealed[p] /\ disk.versions[p] = 1

NamesRequireFlushedBytes == ~r.namedTooSoon

ClosedNumbersNeverReused == ~r.reused

OnlyNamedPiecesAreWhole == r.whole \subseteq disk.pieces \/ r.phase = "removing"

DiskReconcilesRecord ==
    (up /\ r.phase \notin {"name", "removing"}) => r.whole = disk.pieces

NextNumberFollowsDisk ==
    (up /\ r.phase = "ready") =>
        /\ r.next = Last(disk.pieces) + 1
        /\ r.next \notin Closed

OpenRemnantsBlockReuse ==
    (up /\ disk.hidden # "none") =>
        /\ r.open \in Pieces
        /\ r.phase \in {"write", "name", "discard"}
        /\ r.open \notin disk.pieces

JoinUsesEveryClosedPiece ==
    r.inputs # <<>> => r.inputs = Ordered(Closed)

JoinWaitsForCapture ==
    r.inputs # <<>> => (r.final /\ r.open = 0 /\ disk.hidden = "none")

GapDurationsAreExact ==
    r.gapsSaved =>
        /\ r.omitted \subseteq Closed
        /\ \A p \in Pieces : r.gaps[p] = IF p \in r.omitted THEN sealed[p] ELSE 0

NamedJoinHasSavedGaps ==
    disk.join = "named" =>
        /\ r.gapsSaved
        /\ disk.omitted = r.omitted
        /\ disk.gaps = r.gaps
        /\ disk.included = Included(r.inputs, r.omitted)
        /\ Len(disk.included) > 0

OnlyTheJoinedFileIsHandedOver ==
    r.requestFile # "none" =>
        /\ r.requestFile = JoinedId
        /\ r.requestKey = RecordingId
        /\ disk.join = "named"

AtMostOneArchiveFile == archiveCopies <= 1

HandedOverRequiresConfirmation == r.delivered => archiveCopies = 1

FailuresKeepTheRecording ==
    r.phase \in {"joinFailed", "handoverFailed"} =>
        /\ ~r.delivered
        /\ Closed \subseteq disk.pieces

FailuresHaveAnOutcome ==
    /\ r.phase = "joinFailed" =>
        (Outcome.joinError # "none" /\ Outcome.location = SpoolId)
    /\ r.phase = "handoverFailed" =>
        (Outcome.handoverError /\ Outcome.location = SpoolId)

UnreadablePiecesRemain ==
    (disk.join = "named" /\ ~r.expired) => disk.omitted \subseteq disk.pieces

RemovalWaitsForRetention == r.phase \in {"removing", "cleaned"} => (r.delivered /\ r.expired)

WriteFailureStopsCapture == r.writeError => (r.ended /\ r.phase \notin {"write", "name"})

EmptyRecordingHasNoFile ==
    r.phase = "empty" =>
        /\ Closed = {}
        /\ r.inputs = <<>>
        /\ r.requestFile = "none"
        /\ archiveCopies = 0
        /\ Outcome.nothingRecorded

HandoverRetryHasATrigger ==
    (r.phase = "handing" /\ r.handoverError) =>
        r.handoverOrigin \in {"person", "launch", "unresolved"}

FinalizationProgress ==
    (up /\ r.phase = "ready" /\ r.final) ~> (~up \/ r.phase \in {"joining", "empty"})

JoinRetryProgress == (up /\ r.phase = "joinPending") ~> (~up \/ r.phase = "joining")

HandoverProgress == (up /\ r.phase = "joined") ~> (~up \/ r.phase = "handing")

RemovalProgress ==
    (up /\ r.phase = "delivered" /\ r.expired) ~> (~up \/ r.phase = "removing")

NothingWasRecorded == r.phase = "empty"

WriteFailedButClosedPieceSurvived == r.writeError /\ Closed # {} /\ r.phase = "joined"

ResumedAfterUnreportedName == r.recoveredExtra /\ r.phase = "write" /\ r.open = 2

JoinFailedAndKept == r.phase = "joinFailed" /\ r.joinError = "joinError" /\ Closed # {}

AllUnreadableFailed == r.phase = "joinFailed" /\ r.joinError = "unreadable"

PersonRetriedJoin == r.phase = "joining" /\ r.retryOrigin = "person"

LaunchRetriedJoin == r.phase = "joining" /\ r.retryOrigin = "launch"

InterruptedJoinsReachedLimit == r.phase = "joinFailed" /\ r.joinError = "interrupted" /\ r.cuts = JoinCutoff

NamedJoinRecovered == r.phase = "joined" /\ r.handoverOrigin = "recoveredJoin"

RecordingHandedOver == r.delivered /\ r.omitted = {} /\ Closed # {}

RecordingHandedOverWithGap == r.delivered /\ r.omitted # {} /\ Outcome.gaps = r.gaps

HandoverFailedAndKept == r.phase = "handoverFailed" /\ Closed # {}

UnresolvedHandoverDeduplicated == archiveCopies = 1 /\ r.phase = "handing" /\ r.handoverOrigin = "unresolved"

PersonRetriedHandover == r.phase = "handing" /\ r.handoverError /\ r.handoverOrigin = "person"

FailedHandoverRetriedOnLaunch == r.phase = "handing" /\ r.handoverError /\ r.handoverOrigin = "launch"

RetainedAfterHandover == r.phase = "delivered" /\ ~r.expired /\ Closed # {} /\ disk.pieces = Closed

RemovedAfterRetention == r.phase = "cleaned" /\ Closed # {} /\ disk.pieces = {}

\* r is the caller's whole, durable bookkeeping record. Changing r to an
\* operation phase saves the request before the corresponding caller action.
\* disk is the caller's durable disk listing, not I/O performed by this part.
\* sealed and archiveCopies are observation history for safety checks.
\* A disk version of 1 denotes the original bytes; 2 denotes changed bytes.
\* The bounds limit explored recordings, not production recording length.
Init ==
    /\ up = TRUE
    /\ r = [phase |-> "ready", open |-> 0, seconds |-> 0, whole |-> {}, next |-> 1,
        ended |-> FALSE, final |-> FALSE, writeError |-> FALSE, inputs |-> <<>>,
        omitted |-> {}, gaps |-> ZeroSeconds, gapsSaved |-> FALSE, joinError |-> "none",
        handoverError |-> FALSE, delivered |-> FALSE, expired |-> FALSE, cuts |-> 0,
        retryOrigin |-> "initial", handoverOrigin |-> "first", recoveredExtra |-> FALSE,
        namedTooSoon |-> FALSE, reused |-> FALSE, requestFile |-> "none", requestKey |-> "none"]
    /\ disk = [pieces |-> {}, seconds |-> ZeroSeconds, versions |-> ZeroSeconds, hidden |-> "none", join |-> "none",
        included |-> <<>>, omitted |-> {}, gaps |-> ZeroSeconds]
    /\ sealed = ZeroSeconds
    /\ archiveCopies = 0

BeginPiece(piece, duration) ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "ready" /\ ~r.ended /\ ~r.final /\ ~r.writeError
    /\ piece = r.next /\ piece \in Pieces /\ piece \notin disk.pieces /\ disk.hidden = "none"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "write", !.open = piece, !.seconds = duration,
        !.reused = @ \/ piece \in Closed]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

WriteHidden ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "write" /\ disk.hidden = "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = "partial"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

FlushHidden ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "write" /\ disk.hidden = "partial"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = "flushed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportFlushed ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "write" /\ disk.hidden = "flushed"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "name"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

NamePiece ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "name" /\ disk.hidden = "flushed" /\ r.open \notin disk.pieces
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.pieces = @ \cup {r.open}, !.seconds[r.open] = r.seconds,
        !.versions[r.open] = 1, !.hidden = "none"]
    /\ sealed' = [sealed EXCEPT ![r.open] = r.seconds]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, archiveCopies>>

ReportNamed ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "name" /\ r.open \in disk.pieces
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "ready", !.open = 0, !.seconds = 0,
        !.whole = disk.pieces, !.next = Last(disk.pieces) + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportWriteFailure ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase \in {"write", "name"} /\ r.open \notin disk.pieces
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "discard", !.writeError = TRUE, !.ended = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

CaptureEnds ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase \in {"ready", "write", "name", "discard"} /\ ~r.ended /\ ~r.final
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.ended = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

EndForGood ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase \in {"ready", "write", "name", "discard"} /\ ~r.final
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.final = TRUE, !.ended = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

CarryOn ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "ready" /\ r.ended /\ ~r.final /\ ~r.writeError /\ r.next <= MaxPieces
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.ended = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

DiscardHidden ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "discard" /\ disk.hidden # "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportHiddenDiscarded ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "discard" /\ disk.hidden = "none"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "ready", !.open = 0, !.seconds = 0,
        !.next = Last(r.whole) + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

FinishEmpty ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "ready" /\ r.final /\ r.whole = {} /\ r.open = 0
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "empty"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RequestJoin ==
    /\ up /\ (r.phase = "joinPending" \/ (r.phase = "ready" /\ r.final /\ r.whole # {}))
    /\ r.open = 0 /\ disk.hidden = "none" /\ disk.join = "none"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joining", !.inputs = Ordered(r.whole),
        !.omitted = {}, !.gaps = ZeroSeconds, !.gapsSaved = FALSE, !.recoveredExtra = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

WriteJoinPartial ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joining" /\ disk.join = "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.join = "partial"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

SaveJoinGaps(skipped) ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joining" /\ disk.join = "partial"
    /\ skipped \subseteq r.whole /\ skipped # r.whole
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joinReady", !.omitted = skipped,
        !.gaps = [p \in Pieces |-> IF p \in skipped THEN disk.seconds[p] ELSE 0], !.gapsSaved = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

NameJoinedFile ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinReady" /\ disk.join = "partial" /\ r.gapsSaved
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.join = "named", !.included = Included(r.inputs, r.omitted),
        !.omitted = r.omitted, !.gaps = r.gaps]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportJoinNamed ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinReady" /\ disk.join = "named"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joined", !.joinError = "none", !.cuts = 0, !.retryOrigin = "initial"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportJoinFailure(reason) ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase \in {"joining", "joinReady"} /\ disk.join # "named"
    /\ reason # "unreadable" \/ r.phase = "joining"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joinFailed", !.joinError = reason]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

PersonRetriesJoin ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinFailed"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joinCleanup", !.retryOrigin = "person"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

DiscardJoinPartial ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinCleanup" /\ disk.join = "partial"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.join = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportJoinDiscarded ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinCleanup" /\ disk.join = "none"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joinPending", !.omitted = {}, !.gaps = ZeroSeconds, !.gapsSaved = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RequestHandover ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joined" /\ disk.join = "named"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "handing", !.requestFile = JoinedId, !.requestKey = RecordingId]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

CopyAndVerifyHandover ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "handing" /\ archiveCopies = 0
    /\ archiveCopies' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, disk, sealed>>

ReportHandoverSuccess ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "handing" /\ archiveCopies = 1
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "delivered", !.delivered = TRUE, !.handoverError = FALSE,
        !.handoverOrigin = "first"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportHandoverFailure ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "handing"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "handoverFailed", !.handoverError = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

PersonRetriesHandover ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "handoverFailed"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joined", !.handoverOrigin = "person"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RetentionElapsed ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "delivered" /\ ~r.expired
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.expired = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RequestRemoval ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "delivered" /\ r.expired
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "removing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RemovePiece(piece) ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "removing" /\ piece \in disk.pieces
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.pieces = @ \ {piece}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportRemovalFinished ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "removing" /\ disk.pieces = {}
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "cleaned", !.whole = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

Crash ==
    /\ up
    /\ up' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<r, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

Recover ==
    /\ ~up
    /\ up' = TRUE
    /\ LET interrupted == r.phase \in {"joining", "joinReady"} /\ disk.join # "named"
           cuts == IF interrupted /\ r.cuts < JoinCutoff THEN r.cuts + 1 ELSE r.cuts
           limit == interrupted /\ cuts = JoinCutoff
           phase == CASE r.delivered -> r.phase
                     [] disk.join = "named" -> "joined"
                     [] r.phase = "empty" -> "empty"
                     [] limit -> "joinFailed"
                     [] r.phase \in {"joining", "joinReady", "joinFailed", "joinCleanup", "joinPending"} -> "joinCleanup"
                     [] OTHER -> IF disk.hidden # "none" THEN "discard" ELSE "ready"
           handOrigin == CASE r.phase = "handoverFailed" -> "launch"
                          [] r.phase = "handing" -> "unresolved"
                          [] r.phase = "joinReady" /\ disk.join = "named" -> "recoveredJoin"
                          [] OTHER -> r.handoverOrigin
       IN r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = phase, !.whole = disk.pieces,
            !.next = Last(disk.pieces) + 1, !.ended = TRUE,
            !.open = IF disk.hidden = "none" THEN 0 ELSE @,
            !.seconds = IF disk.hidden = "none" THEN 0 ELSE @,
            !.cuts = IF disk.join = "named" THEN 0 ELSE cuts, !.handoverOrigin = handOrigin,
            !.recoveredExtra = @ \/ disk.pieces \ r.whole # {},
            !.joinError = IF limit THEN "interrupted" ELSE IF disk.join = "named" THEN "none" ELSE @,
            !.retryOrigin = IF disk.join = "named" THEN "initial" ELSE IF interrupted THEN "interrupted" ELSE IF r.phase = "joinFailed" THEN "launch" ELSE @]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

Wait == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E piece \in Pieces, duration \in Durations : BeginPiece(piece, duration)
    \/ WriteHidden \/ FlushHidden \/ ReportFlushed \/ NamePiece \/ ReportNamed
    \/ ReportWriteFailure \/ CaptureEnds \/ EndForGood \/ CarryOn
    \/ DiscardHidden \/ ReportHiddenDiscarded \/ FinishEmpty \/ RequestJoin
    \/ WriteJoinPartial \/ (\E skipped \in SUBSET Pieces : SaveJoinGaps(skipped))
    \/ NameJoinedFile \/ ReportJoinNamed
    \/ (\E reason \in {"joinError", "unreadable"} : ReportJoinFailure(reason))
    \/ PersonRetriesJoin \/ DiscardJoinPartial \/ ReportJoinDiscarded
    \/ RequestHandover \/ CopyAndVerifyHandover \/ ReportHandoverSuccess \/ ReportHandoverFailure
    \/ PersonRetriesHandover \/ RetentionElapsed \/ RequestRemoval
    \/ (\E piece \in Pieces : RemovePiece(piece)) \/ ReportRemovalFinished
    \/ Crash \/ Recover \/ Wait

FairJoinRequests == WF_vars(RequestJoin)

model.module_text:
---- MODULE RecordingPieces ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxPieces, Durations, JoinCutoff, RecordingId, SpoolId, JoinedId
VARIABLES up, r, disk, sealed, archiveCopies

vars == <<up, r, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

Pieces == 1..MaxPieces

Seconds == {0} \cup Durations

ZeroSeconds == [p \in Pieces |-> 0]

Closed == {p \in Pieces : sealed[p] # 0}

Ordered(s) ==
    [i \in 1..Cardinality(s) |->
        CHOOSE p \in s : Cardinality({q \in s : q <= p}) = i]

Last(s) == IF s = {} THEN 0 ELSE CHOOSE p \in s : \A q \in s : q <= p

Included(xs, skipped) == SelectSeq(xs, LAMBDA p : p \notin skipped)

ShortSequences == UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces}

Phases ==
    {"ready", "write", "name", "discard", "joinPending", "joining",
     "joinReady", "joinCleanup", "joinFailed", "joined", "handing",
     "handoverFailed", "delivered", "removing", "cleaned", "empty"}

Outcome ==
    [status |-> r.phase, location |-> SpoolId,
     cannotContinue |-> r.writeError,
     joinError |-> r.joinError, handoverError |-> r.handoverError,
     omitted |-> IF disk.join = "named" THEN r.omitted ELSE {},
     gaps |-> IF disk.join = "named" THEN r.gaps ELSE ZeroSeconds,
     nothingRecorded |-> (r.phase = "empty")]

TypeOK ==
    /\ up \in BOOLEAN
    /\ r \in [phase : Phases, open : 0..MaxPieces, seconds : Seconds,
        whole : SUBSET Pieces, next : 1..(MaxPieces + 1), ended : BOOLEAN,
        final : BOOLEAN, writeError : BOOLEAN, inputs : ShortSequences,
        omitted : SUBSET Pieces, gaps : [Pieces -> Seconds], gapsSaved : BOOLEAN,
        joinError : {"none", "joinError", "unreadable", "interrupted"},
        handoverError : BOOLEAN, delivered : BOOLEAN, expired : BOOLEAN,
        cuts : 0..JoinCutoff,
        retryOrigin : {"initial", "person", "launch", "interrupted"},
        handoverOrigin : {"first", "person", "launch", "unresolved", "waiting", "recoveredJoin"},
        recoveredExtra : BOOLEAN, namedTooSoon : BOOLEAN, reused : BOOLEAN,
        requestFile : {"none", JoinedId}, requestKey : {"none", RecordingId}]
    /\ disk \in [pieces : SUBSET Pieces, seconds : [Pieces -> Seconds], versions : [Pieces -> 0..2],
        hidden : {"none", "partial", "flushed"}, join : {"none", "partial", "named"},
        included : ShortSequences, omitted : SUBSET Pieces, gaps : [Pieces -> Seconds]]
    /\ sealed \in [Pieces -> Seconds]
    /\ archiveCopies \in 0..2

ClosedPiecesKept == (~r.delivered \/ ~r.expired) => Closed \subseteq disk.pieces

ClosedPiecesUnchanged ==
    \A p \in Closed : disk.seconds[p] = sealed[p] /\ disk.versions[p] = 1

NamesRequireFlushedBytes == ~r.namedTooSoon

ClosedNumbersNeverReused == ~r.reused

OnlyNamedPiecesAreWhole == r.whole \subseteq disk.pieces \/ r.phase = "removing"

DiskReconcilesRecord ==
    (up /\ r.phase \notin {"name", "removing"}) => r.whole = disk.pieces

NextNumberFollowsDisk ==
    (up /\ r.phase = "ready") =>
        /\ r.next = Last(disk.pieces) + 1
        /\ r.next \notin Closed

OpenRemnantsBlockReuse ==
    (up /\ disk.hidden # "none") =>
        /\ r.open \in Pieces
        /\ r.phase \in {"write", "name", "discard"}
        /\ r.open \notin disk.pieces

JoinUsesEveryClosedPiece ==
    r.inputs # <<>> => r.inputs = Ordered(Closed)

JoinWaitsForCapture ==
    r.inputs # <<>> => (r.final /\ r.open = 0 /\ disk.hidden = "none")

GapDurationsAreExact ==
    r.gapsSaved =>
        /\ r.omitted \subseteq Closed
        /\ \A p \in Pieces : r.gaps[p] = IF p \in r.omitted THEN sealed[p] ELSE 0

NamedJoinHasSavedGaps ==
    disk.join = "named" =>
        /\ r.gapsSaved
        /\ disk.omitted = r.omitted
        /\ disk.gaps = r.gaps
        /\ disk.included = Included(r.inputs, r.omitted)
        /\ Len(disk.included) > 0

OnlyTheJoinedFileIsHandedOver ==
    r.requestFile # "none" =>
        /\ r.requestFile = JoinedId
        /\ r.requestKey = RecordingId
        /\ disk.join = "named"

AtMostOneArchiveFile == archiveCopies <= 1

HandedOverRequiresConfirmation == r.delivered => archiveCopies = 1

FailuresKeepTheRecording ==
    r.phase \in {"joinFailed", "handoverFailed"} =>
        /\ ~r.delivered
        /\ Closed \subseteq disk.pieces

FailuresHaveAnOutcome ==
    /\ r.phase = "joinFailed" =>
        (Outcome.joinError # "none" /\ Outcome.location = SpoolId)
    /\ r.phase = "handoverFailed" =>
        (Outcome.handoverError /\ Outcome.location = SpoolId)

UnreadablePiecesRemain ==
    (disk.join = "named" /\ ~r.expired) => disk.omitted \subseteq disk.pieces

RemovalWaitsForRetention == r.phase \in {"removing", "cleaned"} => (r.delivered /\ r.expired)

WriteFailureStopsCapture == r.writeError => (r.ended /\ r.phase \notin {"write", "name"})

EmptyRecordingHasNoFile ==
    r.phase = "empty" =>
        /\ Closed = {}
        /\ r.inputs = <<>>
        /\ r.requestFile = "none"
        /\ archiveCopies = 0
        /\ Outcome.nothingRecorded

HandoverRetryHasATrigger ==
    (r.phase = "handing" /\ r.handoverError) =>
        r.handoverOrigin \in {"person", "unresolved"}

FinalizationProgress ==
    (up /\ r.phase = "ready" /\ r.final) ~> (~up \/ r.phase \in {"joining", "empty"})

JoinRetryProgress == (up /\ r.phase = "joinPending") ~> (~up \/ r.phase = "joining")

HandoverProgress == (up /\ r.phase = "joined") ~> (~up \/ r.phase = "handing")

RemovalProgress ==
    (up /\ r.phase = "delivered" /\ r.expired) ~> (~up \/ r.phase = "removing")

NothingWasRecorded == r.phase = "empty"

WriteFailedButClosedPieceSurvived == r.writeError /\ Closed # {} /\ r.phase = "joined"

ResumedAfterUnreportedName == r.recoveredExtra /\ r.phase = "write" /\ r.open = 2

JoinFailedAndKept == r.phase = "joinFailed" /\ r.joinError = "joinError" /\ Closed # {}

AllUnreadableFailed == r.phase = "joinFailed" /\ r.joinError = "unreadable"

PersonRetriedJoin == r.phase = "joining" /\ r.retryOrigin = "person"

LaunchRetriedJoin == r.phase = "joining" /\ r.retryOrigin = "launch"

InterruptedJoinsReachedLimit == r.phase = "joinFailed" /\ r.joinError = "interrupted" /\ r.cuts = JoinCutoff

NamedJoinRecovered == r.phase = "joined" /\ r.handoverOrigin = "recoveredJoin"

RecordingHandedOver == r.delivered /\ r.omitted = {} /\ Closed # {}

RecordingHandedOverWithGap == r.delivered /\ r.omitted # {} /\ Outcome.gaps = r.gaps

HandoverFailedAndKept == r.phase = "handoverFailed" /\ Closed # {}

UnresolvedHandoverDeduplicated == archiveCopies = 1 /\ r.phase = "handing" /\ r.handoverOrigin = "unresolved"

PersonRetriedHandover == r.phase = "handing" /\ r.handoverError /\ r.handoverOrigin = "person"

FailedHandoverWaitedOnLaunch == r.phase = "handoverFailed" /\ r.handoverError /\ r.handoverOrigin = "waiting"

RetainedAfterHandover == r.phase = "delivered" /\ ~r.expired /\ Closed # {} /\ disk.pieces = Closed

RemovedAfterRetention == r.phase = "cleaned" /\ Closed # {} /\ disk.pieces = {}

\* r is the caller's whole, durable bookkeeping record. Changing r to an
\* operation phase saves the request before the corresponding caller action.
\* disk is the caller's durable disk listing, not I/O performed by this part.
\* sealed and archiveCopies are observation history for safety checks.
\* A disk version of 1 denotes the original bytes; 2 denotes changed bytes.
\* The bounds limit explored recordings, not production recording length.
Init ==
    /\ up = TRUE
    /\ r = [phase |-> "ready", open |-> 0, seconds |-> 0, whole |-> {}, next |-> 1,
        ended |-> FALSE, final |-> FALSE, writeError |-> FALSE, inputs |-> <<>>,
        omitted |-> {}, gaps |-> ZeroSeconds, gapsSaved |-> FALSE, joinError |-> "none",
        handoverError |-> FALSE, delivered |-> FALSE, expired |-> FALSE, cuts |-> 0,
        retryOrigin |-> "initial", handoverOrigin |-> "first", recoveredExtra |-> FALSE,
        namedTooSoon |-> FALSE, reused |-> FALSE, requestFile |-> "none", requestKey |-> "none"]
    /\ disk = [pieces |-> {}, seconds |-> ZeroSeconds, versions |-> ZeroSeconds, hidden |-> "none", join |-> "none",
        included |-> <<>>, omitted |-> {}, gaps |-> ZeroSeconds]
    /\ sealed = ZeroSeconds
    /\ archiveCopies = 0

BeginPiece(piece, duration) ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "ready" /\ ~r.ended /\ ~r.final /\ ~r.writeError
    /\ piece = r.next /\ piece \in Pieces /\ piece \notin disk.pieces /\ disk.hidden = "none"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "write", !.open = piece, !.seconds = duration,
        !.reused = @ \/ piece \in Closed]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

WriteHidden ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "write" /\ disk.hidden = "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = "partial"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

FlushHidden ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "write" /\ disk.hidden = "partial"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = "flushed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportFlushed ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "write" /\ disk.hidden = "flushed"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "name"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

NamePiece ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "name" /\ disk.hidden = "flushed" /\ r.open \notin disk.pieces
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.pieces = @ \cup {r.open}, !.seconds[r.open] = r.seconds,
        !.versions[r.open] = 1, !.hidden = "none"]
    /\ sealed' = [sealed EXCEPT ![r.open] = r.seconds]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, archiveCopies>>

ReportNamed ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "name" /\ r.open \in disk.pieces
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "ready", !.open = 0, !.seconds = 0,
        !.whole = disk.pieces, !.next = Last(disk.pieces) + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportWriteFailure ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase \in {"write", "name"} /\ r.open \notin disk.pieces
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "discard", !.writeError = TRUE, !.ended = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

CaptureEnds ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase \in {"ready", "write", "name", "discard"} /\ ~r.ended /\ ~r.final
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.ended = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

EndForGood ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase \in {"ready", "write", "name", "discard"} /\ ~r.final
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.final = TRUE, !.ended = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

CarryOn ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "ready" /\ r.ended /\ ~r.final /\ ~r.writeError /\ r.next <= MaxPieces
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.ended = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

DiscardHidden ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "discard" /\ disk.hidden # "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.hidden = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportHiddenDiscarded ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "discard" /\ disk.hidden = "none"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "ready", !.open = 0, !.seconds = 0,
        !.next = Last(r.whole) + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

FinishEmpty ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "ready" /\ r.final /\ r.whole = {} /\ r.open = 0
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "empty"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RequestJoin ==
    /\ up /\ (r.phase = "joinPending" \/ (r.phase = "ready" /\ r.final /\ r.whole # {}))
    /\ r.open = 0 /\ disk.hidden = "none" /\ disk.join = "none"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joining", !.inputs = Ordered(r.whole),
        !.omitted = {}, !.gaps = ZeroSeconds, !.gapsSaved = FALSE, !.recoveredExtra = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

WriteJoinPartial ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joining" /\ disk.join = "none"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.join = "partial"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

SaveJoinGaps(skipped) ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joining" /\ disk.join = "partial"
    /\ skipped \subseteq r.whole /\ skipped # r.whole
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joinReady", !.omitted = skipped,
        !.gaps = [p \in Pieces |-> IF p \in skipped THEN disk.seconds[p] ELSE 0], !.gapsSaved = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

NameJoinedFile ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinReady" /\ disk.join = "partial" /\ r.gapsSaved
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.join = "named", !.included = Included(r.inputs, r.omitted),
        !.omitted = r.omitted, !.gaps = r.gaps]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportJoinNamed ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinReady" /\ disk.join = "named"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joined", !.joinError = "none", !.cuts = 0, !.retryOrigin = "initial"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportJoinFailure(reason) ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase \in {"joining", "joinReady"} /\ disk.join # "named"
    /\ reason # "unreadable" \/ r.phase = "joining"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joinFailed", !.joinError = reason]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

PersonRetriesJoin ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinFailed"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joinCleanup", !.retryOrigin = "person"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

DiscardJoinPartial ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinCleanup" /\ disk.join = "partial"
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.join = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportJoinDiscarded ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joinCleanup" /\ disk.join = "none"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joinPending", !.omitted = {}, !.gaps = ZeroSeconds, !.gapsSaved = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RequestHandover ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "joined" /\ disk.join = "named"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "handing", !.requestFile = JoinedId, !.requestKey = RecordingId]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

CopyAndVerifyHandover ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "handing" /\ archiveCopies = 0
    /\ archiveCopies' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, disk, sealed>>

ReportHandoverSuccess ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "handing" /\ archiveCopies = 1
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "delivered", !.delivered = TRUE, !.handoverError = FALSE,
        !.handoverOrigin = "first"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportHandoverFailure ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "handing"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "handoverFailed", !.handoverError = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

PersonRetriesHandover ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "handoverFailed"
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "joined", !.handoverOrigin = "person"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RetentionElapsed ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "delivered" /\ ~r.expired
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.expired = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RequestRemoval ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "delivered" /\ r.expired
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "removing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

RemovePiece(piece) ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "removing" /\ piece \in disk.pieces
    /\ disk' = [disk EXCEPT !.pieces = @ \ {piece}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, r, sealed, archiveCopies>>

ReportRemovalFinished ==
    /\ up /\ r.phase = "removing" /\ disk.pieces = {}
    /\ r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = "cleaned", !.whole = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

Crash ==
    /\ up
    /\ up' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<r, disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

Recover ==
    /\ ~up
    /\ up' = TRUE
    /\ LET interrupted == r.phase \in {"joining", "joinReady"} /\ disk.join # "named"
           cuts == IF interrupted /\ r.cuts < JoinCutoff THEN r.cuts + 1 ELSE r.cuts
           limit == interrupted /\ cuts = JoinCutoff
           phase == CASE r.delivered -> r.phase
                     [] disk.join = "named" -> IF r.phase = "handoverFailed" THEN "handoverFailed" ELSE "joined"
                     [] r.phase = "empty" -> "empty"
                     [] limit -> "joinFailed"
                     [] r.phase \in {"joining", "joinReady", "joinFailed", "joinCleanup", "joinPending"} -> "joinCleanup"
                     [] OTHER -> IF disk.hidden # "none" THEN "discard" ELSE "ready"
           handOrigin == CASE r.phase = "handoverFailed" -> "waiting"
                          [] r.phase = "handing" -> "unresolved"
                          [] r.phase = "joinReady" /\ disk.join = "named" -> "recoveredJoin"
                          [] OTHER -> r.handoverOrigin
       IN r' = [r EXCEPT !.phase = phase, !.whole = disk.pieces,
            !.next = Last(disk.pieces) + 1, !.ended = TRUE,
            !.open = IF disk.hidden = "none" THEN 0 ELSE @,
            !.seconds = IF disk.hidden = "none" THEN 0 ELSE @,
            !.cuts = IF disk.join = "named" THEN 0 ELSE cuts, !.handoverOrigin = handOrigin,
            !.recoveredExtra = @ \/ disk.pieces \ r.whole # {},
            !.joinError = IF limit THEN "interrupted" ELSE IF disk.join = "named" THEN "none" ELSE @,
            !.retryOrigin = IF disk.join = "named" THEN "initial" ELSE IF interrupted THEN "interrupted" ELSE IF r.phase = "joinFailed" THEN "launch" ELSE @]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<disk, sealed, archiveCopies>>

Wait == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E piece \in Pieces, duration \in Durations : BeginPiece(piece, duration)
    \/ WriteHidden \/ FlushHidden \/ ReportFlushed \/ NamePiece \/ ReportNamed
    \/ ReportWriteFailure \/ CaptureEnds \/ EndForGood \/ CarryOn
    \/ DiscardHidden \/ ReportHiddenDiscarded \/ FinishEmpty \/ RequestJoin
    \/ WriteJoinPartial \/ (\E skipped \in SUBSET Pieces : SaveJoinGaps(skipped))
    \/ NameJoinedFile \/ ReportJoinNamed
    \/ (\E reason \in {"joinError", "unreadable"} : ReportJoinFailure(reason))
    \/ PersonRetriesJoin \/ DiscardJoinPartial \/ ReportJoinDiscarded
    \/ RequestHandover \/ CopyAndVerifyHandover \/ ReportHandoverSuccess \/ ReportHandoverFailure
    \/ PersonRetriesHandover \/ RetentionElapsed \/ RequestRemoval
    \/ (\E piece \in Pieces : RemovePiece(piece)) \/ ReportRemovalFinished
    \/ Crash \/ Recover \/ Wait

FairJoinRequests == WF_vars(RequestJoin)

FairEmptyOutcome == WF_vars(FinishEmpty)

FairHandoverRequests == WF_vars(RequestHandover)

FairRemovalRequests == WF_vars(RequestRemoval)

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The recording starts in Init and changes only through the modeled bookkeeping and caller steps.

pins.name: ClosedPiecesKept
pins.says: Every closed piece stays on disk until hand-over is confirmed and the three-day retention period has passed.

pins.name: NextNumberFollowsDisk
pins.says: Whenever the recording can take another piece, its number follows the last piece named on disk and never reuses a closed number.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: The saved record, disk observations and hand-over observations always have their declared types.

pins.name: ClosedPiecesUnchanged
pins.says: The contents represented by each closed piece remain unchanged.

pins.name: NamesRequireFlushedBytes
pins.says: A piece receives its name only after its bytes have been flushed to durable storage.

pins.name: ClosedNumbersNeverReused
pins.says: A new write never takes the number of a previously closed piece.

pins.name: OnlyNamedPiecesAreWhole
pins.says: Only named pieces count as whole, except for saved entries awaiting acknowledgement during permitted cleanup.

pins.name: DiskReconcilesRecord
pins.says: After recovery or a completed callback, the closed-piece record agrees with the named pieces on disk.

pins.name: OpenRemnantsBlockReuse
pins.says: An unfinished hidden piece can only be written, named after flushing or discarded before its number is reused.

pins.name: JoinUsesEveryClosedPiece
pins.says: Every join request contains every closed piece exactly once in increasing piece order.

pins.name: JoinWaitsForCapture
pins.says: A join is requested only after capture is to finish for good and no piece is open.

pins.name: GapDurationsAreExact
pins.says: Every saved omission names a closed piece and records exactly its duration as a gap.

pins.name: NamedJoinHasSavedGaps
pins.says: A named joined file contains at least one readable piece in order and agrees with omission and gap details saved before it was named.

pins.name: OnlyTheJoinedFileIsHandedOver
pins.says: Every hand-over request identifies the one whole joined file and uses the recording’s stable identity.

pins.name: AtMostOneArchiveFile
pins.says: Deduplicated hand-over creates at most one archive file for this recording.

pins.name: HandedOverRequiresConfirmation
pins.says: A recording is counted as handed over only after its archive copy has been verified.

pins.name: FailuresKeepTheRecording
pins.says: A failed join or hand-over leaves the recording undelivered and keeps every closed piece.

pins.name: FailuresHaveAnOutcome
pins.says: A failed join or hand-over reports its error together with the spool location.

pins.name: UnreadablePiecesRemain
pins.says: Pieces omitted as unreadable remain in the spool through the retention period after hand-over.

pins.name: RemovalWaitsForRetention
pins.says: Piece cleanup can start or finish only after confirmed hand-over and the caller’s report that the three-day retention period has passed.

pins.name: WriteFailureStopsCapture
pins.says: A failed piece write reports that capture cannot continue and accepts no further piece from that capture.

pins.name: EmptyRecordingHasNoFile
pins.says: A recording with no closed piece reports that nothing was recorded and requests no join or hand-over.

pins.name: HandoverRetryHasATrigger
pins.says: After a reported hand-over failure, only a person’s request permits a retry, while an interrupted retry may still be recovered with the same identity.

pins.name: FinalizationProgress
pins.says: While On Air remains running, a finalized capture eventually requests joining or reports that nothing was recorded.

pins.name: JoinRetryProgress
pins.says: While On Air remains running, a retry whose partial-file cleanup is acknowledged eventually requests joining again.

pins.name: HandoverProgress
pins.says: While On Air remains running, a joined recording eligible for hand-over eventually requests it.

pins.name: RemovalProgress
pins.says: While On Air remains running, a delivered recording whose retention period has passed eventually requests piece cleanup.

pins.name: FairEmptyOutcome

pins.name: JoinFailedAndKept

answers.question: If On Air dies after the joined file gets its name but before the join result is saved, how should the gap information survive?
answers.says: The caller reports the omitted pieces and gap durations before naming the joined file, and waits until this part has saved them.

answers.question: If On Air dies during hand-over before its result is saved, how should this part recover the unresolved hand-over?
answers.says: The part retries the same hand-over request after recovery, and the hand-over part deduplicates it using the recording’s stable identity.
